description.value: "An ArgoCD Application's live state diverged from the desired state in Git. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2."

properties.revision.description.value: "Git revision (full SHA) the desired state came from."

properties.driftedResources.description.value: "The diverging resources, truncated at 100. `driftedResourceCount` is the true total: an event is a notification, not a transport (subjects.v1.yaml `limits.body_rule`)."

properties.driftedResourceCount.descript.value: "Total diverging resources, which may exceed `driftedResources` length."

description.value: "An ArgoCD Application reached Synced at a revision. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2."

properties.revision.description.value: "Git revision (full SHA) the desired state came from."

properties.health.description.value: "ArgoCD health status at the moment of sync. Sync and health are separate facts and a consumer that conflates them will act on a synced-but-degraded app."

properties.syncedAt.description.value: "RFC3339 time ArgoCD recorded the sync. Distinct from the envelope `time`, which is when the bridge published."

description.value: "A principal was issued credentials. AUDIT RECORD: this type is sourced into PF_AUDIT and kept 365 days. It carries the FACT of issuance and never the credential itself. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2."

properties.principalId.description.value: "Stable opaque identifier for the principal. Not an email address and not a name."

properties.principalType.description.value: "Kind of principal. `ai-agent` is a first-class type, not a service account with a convention."

properties.issuer.description.value: "Identity center that issued it, as an operator-supplied issuer URI. Never a hard-coded provider."

properties.credentialRef.description.value: "Reference to where the credential lives (e.g. a secret store path). NEVER the credential material — an audit stream holding secrets is a 365-day breach."

properties.expiresAt.description.value: "RFC3339 expiry. Absent means non-expiring, which is itself an auditable fact."

description.value: "A principal's credentials were revoked. AUDIT RECORD, 365-day retention, and the counterpart to identity.principal.issued.v1. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2."

properties.reason.description.value: "Why revocation happened. `compromised` is the one a security consumer must treat as an incident trigger."

properties.revokedBy.description.value: "Principal id of whoever or whatever performed the revocation. An automated rotation names the component."

properties.effectiveAt.description.value: "RFC3339 time the revocation takes effect; may be earlier than the envelope `time` when a revocation is recorded after the fact."

description.value: "A cluster node was replaced. Reported after the replacement joined and the old member was removed, so a consumer never sees a half-replaced pair. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2."

properties.talosVersion.description.value: "Talos version the new node booted, as reported by the node — not the pinned value from config."

properties.etcdMemberRemoved.description.value: "Control planes only: whether the old etcd member was removed from the member list. False here means quorum arithmetic still counts the old member."

description.value: "An SLO error budget is burning fast enough to need attention. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2."

properties.burnRate.description.value: "Observed burn rate as a multiple of the budget-neutral rate. 1.0 exhausts the budget exactly at the end of the SLO period."

properties.threshold.description.value: "Burn rate that triggered this event, so a consumer need not know the alerting rules to render severity."

description.value: "A bootstrap run advanced one stage. Emitted by the CLI so a dashboard can follow a fork operator's first install; every event of one run shares a `correlationid`. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2."

properties.stage.description.value: "Stage identifier, stable across runs and forks (e.g. `talos-config`, `cilium`, `argocd`, `app-of-apps`)."

properties.stageIndex.description.value: "Zero-based position of this stage in the run."

properties.stageCount.description.value: "Total stages in the run, so a consumer can render progress without knowing the stage list."

properties.durationSeconds.description.value: "Wall-clock seconds for the stage; absent on `started`."

properties.message.description.value: "Human-readable detail. Never parsed, and MUST NOT carry secrets or rendered config."

description.value: "A workload stopped meeting its readiness or availability target. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2."

properties.reason.description.value: "Why the workload is degraded. `Unknown` is deliberate: a consumer must handle a reason it does not recognise rather than fail closed on an enum it was compiled against."

properties.message.description.value: "Human-readable detail. Never parsed by a consumer — the machine-readable fact is `reason`."

description.value: "A workload reached its desired replica count and passed readiness at a known revision. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2."

properties.revision.description.value: "Git revision (full SHA) the desired state came from."

properties.image.description.value: "Fully-qualified image reference, digest-pinned where the workload is."

properties.replicas.description.value: "Ready replica count observed at the time of the event."

properties.observedGeneration.descriptio.value: "metadata.generation the controller had reconciled. Lets a consumer discard a stale event without ordering guarantees."

description.value: "Synchronous request for the current observed state of a workload. Core NATS, at-most-once: THE RESPONDER MUST BE IDEMPOTENT because the requester retries on timeout and cannot distinguish a lost request from a lost reply. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2."

properties.includeConditions.description.value: "Include the workload's status conditions in the reply. Default false; a reply is bounded by `limits.max_event_bytes` like any other message."

description.value: "Durable request to promote a workload to a revision. At-least-once on PF_WORK, so the handler MUST be idempotent on the envelope `(source, id)`. The outcome comes back as workload.deployment.promoted.v1 carrying this request's `correlationid`, never as a reply. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2."

properties.toRevision.description.value: "Git revision (full SHA) the desired state came from."

properties.fromRevision.description.value: "Revision the requester believes the workload is on. When present the handler MUST refuse the promote if the live revision differs — an optimistic-concurrency guard against two promotes racing."

properties.strategy.description.value: "Promotion strategy. Absent means the workload's configured default."

properties.requestedBy.description.value: "Principal id that asked for the promote. Audit trail for an action that changes running state."

description.value: "The completion event for a durable promote request. Carries the outcome the requester cannot get from a reply, and is joined to its request by the envelope `correlationid`. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2."

properties.fromRevision.description.value: "Revision the workload was on before the promote."

properties.toRevision.description.value: "Git revision (full SHA) the desired state came from."

properties.outcome.description.value: "Terminal outcome of the promote. `superseded` means a newer promote for the same target took over; the requester's work is done but not by this request."
